verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at kling.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Its content is structured for agents: a product summary, RESTful API auth details (JWT AccessKey + SecretKey), global and China API endpoints, model capabilities, and machine-readable plan and pricing fields. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming it, and evidence of deeper agent-oriented docs such as an llms-full.txt or a full endpoint-level API reference in markdown.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
